name: Sichuan Xunyou Network Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Sichuan Xunyou Network Technology Co., Ltd. provides network services for real-time interactive applications in China and internationally. It operates through Game Acceleration Section; and Overseas Advertising Display Section segments. The company offers Xunyou, an online game accelerator and mobile game accelerator, as well as advertising display and paid subscription services based on mobile internet application software. Sichuan Xunyou Network Technology Co., Ltd. was founded in 2008 and is headquartered in Chengdu, China.
